title: People management
accessAllWarning: Admission is wide open on this machine (CSA_ACCESS_ALL=true): the list has no effect yet and any OMS account can sign in. Roles and viewer plants still apply.

roleHint.signer: Sees only the assessments they have a step on
roleHint.viewer: Senior managers: read-only access to every assessment of the chosen plants, progress tracking and exports
roleHint.audit_staff: Like a user while running no plant; as a plant coordinator, also the Taipei audit step on that plant’s routes, and may export Excel
roleHint.audit_admin: Exactly one in the company: maintains question banks, routes, launches, assignments and progress tracking, and names plant coordinators; naming a new one turns the previous one back into a user
roleHint.system_maintainer: Everything: what the audit administrator does, plus letting people in and setting roles and viewed plants (audit administrator and system maintainers included)

empty: Nobody on the list matches (only audit administrators and system maintainers see People management)

form.empIdsPlaceholder: Paste several at once, separated by commas or new lines
form.viewerPlantsHint: Several allowed, from the plant master only; starts with the OMS plant
form.viewerPlantsRequired: A viewer needs at least one plant
form.notePlaceholder: e.g. new auditor, Fuqing plant manager
form.batchShared: Everyone in this batch gets the same role, plants and note
form.takeover: {{from}} runs {{plant}} now; on save {{to}} takes over and {{from}} steps down.
form.maintainerStepsDown: They run {{plants}}: as a system maintainer they step down, and those plants have no coordinator until someone else is assigned.

plan.not_in_oms: OMS has no such ID; not added
plan.stillLooking: Still asking OMS, try again in a moment
plan.departed: OMS records them as having left; not added
plan.on_leave: OMS records them as on unpaid leave; not added
plan.transferred: An old ID from before a transfer; not added, use the new ID
plan.noCsa: CSA is not ticked for them in OMS yet (or no active account); ask the OMS administrator

lookupErrors.not_signed_in: Your session has expired, please sign in again
lookupErrors.not_allowed: You may not look people up by ID
lookupErrors.oms_not_configured: This environment has no key for the OMS channel yet; ask the system maintainer
lookupErrors.oms_key_rejected: OMS refused this environment’s channel key (it may have been replaced or revoked); ask the system maintainer
lookupErrors.oms_rate_limited: OMS’s lookup limit for today has been reached; try again tomorrow
lookupErrors.other: The lookup service did not answer: {{code}}
lookupErrors.too_many: Too many IDs at once; paste them in smaller batches
lookupErrors.lookup_failed: CSA’s lookup service failed; try again in a moment

plan.no_csa: CSA is not ticked for them in OMS; not added, ask the OMS administrator

removeIntro: Takes them off the access list, back to user, with no viewer plants and no plants to run; sign-off history and progress tracking still show their name. They are signed out at the next renewal (within about 45 minutes) and cannot sign in again.
removeSelf: You are removing yourself: afterwards you can no longer open People management.
removePlants: They are the plant coordinator of {{plants}}: once removed, these plants have none until someone is named.
impactLoading: Looking for their steps on routes…
impactNone: They are on no step of an assessment in progress or of a route.
impactWarning: They are still on these steps and must be replaced there before removal: on routes by the audit administrator or the plant coordinator, on issued assessments by the audit administrator. Off the list they cannot sign in, so nobody could sign these steps. A linked “Taipei audit” step changes by itself once the audit administrator names the plant’s new coordinator.

impact.current: Assessments in progress: their turn now
impact.later: Assessments in progress: their turn later

errors.lastAdmin: At least one audit administrator must remain: make someone else one first
errors.notListed: This person is no longer on the list (someone may have just removed them); please reload
errors.plant: A chosen plant is not in the plant master; reload and choose again
errors.lastMaintainer: At least one system maintainer must remain: make someone else one first
errors.maintainerOnly: Only a system maintainer lets people in and sets roles, viewed plants and notes
errors.stillAssigned: They are still on a step: replace them there first
errors.maintainerNotCoordinator: A system maintainer cannot run a plant (they already assign and replace signers at every plant)
errors.singleAdmin: There is exactly one audit administrator; add only one at a time

log.footnote: The log can only grow: nobody can change or delete it. Replacing a plant coordinator or the audit administrator leaves one row, on the person taking over, with the predecessor in its content.

coordinator.replaceWarning: {{name}} steps down and no longer sees the assessments of {{plant}}. If the new coordinator is audit staff or the audit chief, the unsigned Taipei audit steps move to them; {{name}}'s other steps on routes stay.
coordinator.removeConfirm: {{plant}} will have no coordinator until someone is assigned; {{name}} stays on the access list.
coordinator.chiefBoth: With the audit chief running this plant, the Taipei audit step follows them too: they sign both the Taipei audit and the audit chief steps
coordinator.notLinked: The Taipei audit step of this plant’s routes will not follow them; set it in each route

guide.rule: Answering, submitting, approving and returning follow the route, not these roles: whoever’s step it is may act, and not even the audit administrator signs for someone else. One person may hold several roles; the plants they see add up, except in progress tracking’s Excel export: plants seen only as a plant-side coordinator are left out, while audit staff export the plants they run.
guide.matrixTitle: Roles and what they may do

row.ownAssessments: See the assessments they have a step on
row.allAnswers: See every assessment and its answers
row.assign: Assign signers and the plant manager
row.replace: Replace someone on a step not yet signed
row.tracking: Progress tracking, plant progress on My to-dos
row.templates: Question banks, assessing units (audit staff only add units)
row.flows: Approval routes (extra step, not applicable, audit steps)
row.access: See the people list and the people change log
row.admit: Let people in, set roles, viewed plants and notes (audit administrator and system maintainers included)

signer.note: Gets in once a system maintainer adds them to the access list

coordinator.note: A plant-side person. One per plant, one person may run several, no deputies; the routes’ steps do not follow

Fills the last step of every route, and the Taipei audit step of any plant they run; cannot sign someone else’s step
audit_admin.note: Exactly one; naming a new one turns the previous one into a user

points: Everything: question banks, routes, launches, assigning and replacing signers
Every plant's assessments, answers, progress tracking and exports
The only one who lets people in and sets roles and viewed plants (audit administrators and system maintainers included)
system_maintainer.note: At least one must remain; cannot run a plant

guide.coordinatorRule: One coordinator per plant, one person may run several, no deputies; picked from the access list, and leaving the list ends it. Audit staff come first, the audit chief may run a plant too; picking someone from the plant is allowed, but then the Taipei audit step of that plant’s routes is not linked.

people.title: People
people.footHint: Click a name to see the plants they run on the right

rights.title: Edit plants
rights.view: These are the plants this viewer views: their assessments and progress tracking. At least one.
rights.run: These are the plants this person runs as coordinator, one per plant; a plant someone else runs is handed over on save.
rights.fixed: A system maintainer sees every plant and runs none; nothing to set here.
rights.viewerRuns: They also run {{plants}}: change the plants they run from the plant cells on the right.
